description: This file defines composable UI components for displaying and managing a list of official mirrors in an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It includes functions for rendering mirror items, a preview function, and references external UI components and data models.

methods.name: OfficialMirrors
methods.description: Composable function that displays a list of official mirror items within an expandable section.

methods.name: OfficialMirrorRow
methods.description: Composable function that renders a single mirror item with toggle functionality.

methods.name: OfficialMirrorsPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for visualizing the mirrors list in Android Studio.
